register.title: Samee akoonkaaga
register.subtitle: Ku biir FursadHub maanta

roleSelector.label: Waxaan doonayaa inaan ku biiro sida
roleSelector.studentHint: Hel tababaro, codso, oo la soco meelayntaada. Markaad gasho kadib, jaamacaddaadu waxay xaqiijisaa diiwaangelintaada.
roleSelector.organizationHint: Daabac tababaro oo maamul ardayda tababarka ku jira. Markaad gasho kadib, waxaad diyaarisaa ururkaaga oo u gudbisaa xaqiijin.
roleSelector.universityHint: Xaqiiji ardaydaada oo kormeer tababarkooda. Markaad gasho kadib, waxaad diiwaangelisaa jaamacaddaada oo u gudbisaa xaqiijin.

register.acceptTermsRequired: Waa inaad ogolaataa shuruudaha ka hor inta aadan akoon samayn.

errors.EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: Akoon ciwaankan email ah leh ayaa hore u jiray.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Isku day badan. Fadlan sug wax yar oo mar kale isku day.
errors.generic: Hadda lama abuuri karin akoonkaaga. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.

register.passwordHint: Ugu yaraan 8 xaraf, oo ay ku jiraan xaraf iyo lambar.
register.nextStep: Kadib, waxaan iimaylkaaga kuugu soo diri doonnaa koodh 4-tirig ah si aad u xaqiijiso cinwaankaaga.
register.staffNote: Shaqaalaha jaamacadaha iyo ururrada halkan iskama diiwaangeliyaan — maamulahaaga ayaa akoonkaaga sameeya.

passwordRules.title: Furahaagu wuxuu u baahan yahay
passwordRules.letter: Ugu yaraan hal xaraf alifbeeto ah

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Email ama furaha sirta ah waa khalad.
errors.ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: Akoonkan waa la joojiyay. La xiriir taageerada.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Isku day badan. Fadlan sug wax yar oo mar kale isku day.
errors.generic: Hadda laguma soo gelin karin. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.

verifyEmail.title: Xaqiiji emailkaaga
verifyEmail.subtitle: Geli koodhka 4-tirig ah ee aan u dirnay {{email}}
verifyEmail.successTitle: Emailka si guul leh ayaa loo xaqiijiyay
verifyEmail.continue: Sii wad si aad u soo galo
verifyEmail.missingEmailTitle: Geli emailkaaga si aad u sii wado
verifyEmail.missingEmailBody: Waxaan kuu diri doonaa koodh xaqiijin cusub.

errors.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_INVALID: Koodkaas sax ma aha, ama hore ayaa loo isticmaalay. Hubi emaylka ugu dambeeyay, ama gal haddii ciwaankan hore loo xaqiijiyay.
errors.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_EXPIRED: Koodhkani wuu dhacay. Hoos ka codso mid cusub.
errors.EMAIL_VERIFICATION_CODE_LOCKED: Isku day badan oo khalad ah. Codso koodh cusub.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Isku day badan. Fadlan sug wax yar oo mar kale isku day.
errors.generic: Hadda lama hubin karin koodhkaas. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.

verifyEmail.verifyingBody: Waxaa lagu hubinayaa koodkaaga FursadHub. Waxay qaadanaysaa daqiiqad kaliya.
verifyEmail.successBodyOrganization: Emaylkaagu waa la xaqiijiyay. Sii wad dejinta hay'addaada.
verifyEmail.successBodyUniversity: Emaylkaagu waa la xaqiijiyay. Sii wad dejinta machadkaaga.
verifyEmail.expiredBody: Koodadka xaqiijinta waa kuwo muddo gaaban ah amniga awgiis. Codso mid cusub, isla markiiba ayaan kuu soo dirinaa.
verifyEmail.lockedTitle: Isku dayo khaldan oo aad u badan
verifyEmail.lockedBody: Amnigaaga awgiis koodkan mar dambe lama isticmaali karo. Codso mid cusub si aad u sii wadato.
verifyEmail.registeredNotice: Akoonkaaga waa la abuuray. Geli koodka hoose si aad u xaqiijiso ciwaanka emaylkaaga.
verifyEmail.autoHint: Geli dhammaan 4-ta tirig — koodhka waa la hubiyaa isla markaad qorto kan ugu dambeeya.

forgotPassword.title: Furaha sirta ah ma illowday?
forgotPassword.subtitle: Geli emailkaaga waxaanan kuu soo diri doonaa link aad ku dib-u-dejiso furahaaga sirta ah.
forgotPassword.successBody: Haddii akoon ciwaankan email ah leh jiro, link dib-u-dejin ayaa la diray.

resetPassword.title: Samee furaha sirta ah ee cusub
resetPassword.subtitle: Furahaaga cusub ee sirta ah waa inuu ka duwanaadaa kuwii hore la isticmaalay.
resetPassword.newPasswordPlaceholder: Geli furaha sirta ah ee cusub
resetPassword.confirmPasswordPlaceholder: Xaqiiji furaha sirta ah ee cusub
resetPassword.submit: Dib U Deji Furaha Sirta Ah
resetPassword.successTitle: Furaha sirta ah waa la cusboonaysiiyay
resetPassword.successBody: Furahaaga sirta ah waa la dib-u-dejiyay. Fadlan mar kale soo gal.
resetPassword.continue: Sii wad si aad u soo galo

errors.PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: Linkigan dib-u-dejinta waa khalad ama hore ayaa loo isticmaalay.
errors.generic: Hadda dib looma dejin karin furahaaga sirta ah. Hubi xiriirkaaga oo isku day mar kale.

resetPassword.missingTokenBody: Linkiyada dib-u-dejinta furaha waxay sitaan calaamad hal mar la isticmaalo. Fur linkiga emaylkaaga ku jira, ama codso mid cusub.
resetPassword.linkDeadBody: Linkiyada dib-u-dejinta way dhacaan, hal marna ayaa la isticmaali karaa. Codso mid cusub, isla markiiba ayaan kuu soo dirinaa.

getStarted.title: Dooro sida aad u rabto inaad u isticmaasho FursadHub
getStarted.subtitle: Akoonkaagu waa diyaar. Dooro waxa aad marka hore diyaarinayso.
